exclusions.source_text: Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) performance status of ≤ 2.
Total bilirubin ≤ 1.5 ×institutional upper limit of normal (ULN)\*
Pregnant women are excluded from this study because venetoclax has the potential to cause embryo-fetal harm
Patients with a history of other primary malignancy are excluded when they require therapy that will interfere with the investigational treatments.
Known Human immunodeficiency virus (HIV) infection which is treated with agents that can interfere with venetoclax due to potential drug-drug interactions or increased risk of myelotoxicity.
History or presence of cardiovascular disease, which in the Investigator's opinion may impact the clinical trial participation. Patients with a QTcF \> 470 msec at screening.
Age ≥18 years, at the time of signing the IRB approved informed consent.
